identification: Oak brass-bound cutlery canteen/box, c.1830s, with fitted green baize tray and engraved trade label of Widdowson & Veale (late John Salter), Jewellers, Goldsmiths, Sword Cutlers to HRH Duke of Sussex, 73 Strand, London. Empty, central lid plaque missing, label torn and stained, baize worn.
